title: Story premise EDU109: The Emergency Address Has a Missing Piece
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (public safety/preparedness). Hook: Which of these two buildings does the message mean? Takeaway/theme: Clear location information matters when communicating an emergency.
description: A preparedness class wants to practice describing a fictional location, but a landmark-only message leaves two possible buildings. A reviewed practice card adds the location details needed by the relevant local emergency system.
